description: This file provides PHP classes and functions for implementing an XML-RPC client, including request/response handling, XML parsing handlers, and supporting utility functions. It appears to be part of a third-party library 'phpxmlrpc' used for XML-RPC communication in PHP.

classes.name: xmlrpc_client
classes.description: Handles XML-RPC client operations including request sending over HTTP, HTTPS, and using cURL, with support for multicall, proxies, authentication, and compression.

classes.name: xmlrpcresp
classes.description: Represents an XML-RPC response, encapsulating the return value, fault codes, and serialization methods.

classes.name: xmlrpcmsg
classes.description: Constructs an XML-RPC message to invoke remote methods, serialize to XML, and manage parameters.

classes.name: xmlrpcval
classes.description: Represents XML-RPC data values of various types including scalar, array, and struct, providing methods for serialization, type checking, and data access.

methods.name: xmlrpc_client
methods.description: Constructor initializing connection parameters and configuration for the XML-RPC client.

methods.name: setDebug
methods.description: Enables or disables debug output for the client.

methods.name: setCredentials
methods.description: Sets HTTP Basic Authentication credentials.

methods.name: setCertificate
methods.description: Adds SSL certificate details for HTTPS connections.

methods.name: setCaCertificate
methods.description: Adds CA certificate or directory for server verification.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the client SSL private key and its password.

methods.name: setSSLVerifyPeer
methods.description: Enables/disables SSL peer verification.

methods.name: setSSLVerifyHost
methods.description: Sets verification level for server hostname in SSL certificates.

methods.name: setProxy
methods.description: Configures HTTP proxy settings.

methods.name: setAcceptedCompression
methods.description: Specifies accepted response compression schemes.

methods.name: setRequestCompression
methods.description: Specifies compression for outgoing requests.

methods.name: setCookie
methods.description: Adds a cookie to be sent with requests.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends an XML-RPC message and returns the response object.

methods.name: sendPayloadHTTP10
methods.description: Internal method to send payload over HTTP/1.0.

methods.name: sendPayloadHTTPS
methods.description: Internal method to send payload over HTTPS.

methods.name: sendPayloadCURL
methods.description: Internal method to send payload using cURL.

methods.name: multicall
methods.description: Attempts batch calling multiple methods via system.multicall, falling back if unsupported.

methods.name: _try_multicall
methods.description: Internal method to build and send system.multicall requests.

methods.name: method
methods.description: Gets or sets the XML-RPC method name to invoke.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Returns the XML representation of the XML-RPC message, including the XML prologue.

methods.name: addParam
methods.description: Adds a parameter object to the message parameters list, validating that it is of type xmlrpcval.

methods.name: getParam
methods.description: Retrieves the nth parameter object from the message.

methods.name: getNumParams
methods.description: Returns the total number of parameters added.

methods.name: parseResponseFile
methods.description: Reads and parses an XML-RPC response from a file handle.

methods.name: parseResponseHeaders
methods.description: Parses HTTP headers from response data, handling proxy tunneling, chunked transfer encoding, and gzip/deflate decompression, separating headers from the body.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses received data to create an xmlrpcresp object, processing HTTP headers, XML content, and error conditions.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Comprehensive function to parse raw response data, handle encoding, and generate corresponding response objects.
